# Verification results

Counts from loading and verifying the real FDA files. Raw rows are the data lines in
FDA's files; kept rows belong to the one report kept per case under the
[case selection rules](../rules/case_selection.md). Each database is counted on its
own here; the [combined count](#both-databases-combined) follows. The per-database
counts are from the project's ingestion ledgers; running `01_ingest.py` and
`02_verify.py` on the same ZIPs reproduced the kept-case counts exactly. The SHA-256 fingerprint lets
anyone check they have the same FDA file.

## Both databases combined

The [X1 rule](../rules/case_selection.md#rule-x1-two-databases-one-series) reads both
databases as one series, so a case reported in both counts once. These counts come
from the verified run of this ingestion, verification and munging code on all 55
quarters (2026-11-02); the RQ datasets are built from the same `cases` table:

| Step | Cases |
|---|---:|
| Kept cases, historical database alone | 11,406,523 |
| Kept cases, current database alone | 6,433,927 |
| Combined kept cases (`cases` table), after rule X1 and the DQ-038 exclusion | 17,585,091 |
| ADHD study group | 94,803 |
| Stimulant | 81,998 |
| Nonstimulant | 11,805 |
| Both classes (kept apart) | 1,000 |
| RQ3 training cases (received before 2025) | 22,948 |
| RQ3 test cases (received January 2025 - February 2026) | 9,356 |

Without the DQ-038 exclusion the combined list has 17,585,777 cases; the rule removes
686.
